title: End one session or all my sessions
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Implement current-session sign-out and confirmed account-wide sign-out. Clear local access on uncertain response and explain how to retry.

**Verify** · Use A and B for one account and C for another. Cancel, sign out of one session, sign out of all, drop the response and reopen. C retains access throughout.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-062, WI-063

**Queue** · Follows WI-063 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
evidence: Current-session sign-out leaves another session alive; account-wide sign-out ends every session for that account and leaves another member working. The dialog and server test cover cancel and confirm.
